name: website-opportunity-hunter
description: Find UK businesses that are in the best possible moment to buy a website.

scripts.build: npm run db:generate && npm run -w @woh/web build
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/config/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/db/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/core/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/worker/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/web/tsconfig.json
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run test
